label: POC Onboarding: Import Environments
mcp_tool_description: Create one environment per location on a resource handler, exactly as the handler page's Import locations dialog does: one AWS VPC (pass <region>|<vpc-id>; the region alone works only when it has one VPC, and a VPC without subnets is refused), one Azure location, one vCenter, SCVMM or Nutanix cluster, one GCP project. AWS subnets are imported with the environment and Azure subnets are synced; for every technology, choose the NIC 1 networks next with onb_environment_networks. A handler's first AWS environment also adds the Name and Annotation tags that the handler form's Done would add. A location that already has an environment is reported as existing. At most four locations per call; a POC needs one per handler. Echo the locations to the user and confirm before calling. Runs as a job: poll the returned id with fetch_job. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
